takeaway: Change in bowel habit over 3 weeks, rectal bleeding, abdominal pain and poor appetite in an older patient suggest colorectal cancer; median age at rectal cancer diagnosis is 63.

lines.text: A 63-year-old man comes in with bowel symptoms.
lines.say: A sixty-three-year-old man comes in with bowel symptoms.

lines.text: He has had diarrhoea for a month: a change in bowel habit lasting more than three weeks,
He also has occasional abdominal pain,
These are common symptoms of colorectal cancer: here, a rectal carcinoma.
The risk rises with age; the median age at diagnosis of rectal cancer is 63.
lines.say: The risk rises with age; the median age at diagnosis of rectal cancer is sixty-three.

lines.text: Other warning signs: dark stools, weight loss and fatigue.
